description: Contrast (both-directions): RFC 8785 §3.2.3 sorts member names by their UTF-16 code units — the unescaped character values, not the bytes of the escaped serialization. For keys U+001F (0x001F) and U+0020 SPACE (0x0020), the correct order is U+001F first (code unit 0x001F < 0x0020). A wrong implementation that sorts by the escaped byte sequence sees the space key (0x20) sort before the backslash that opens \u001f (0x5C), producing the wrong order (space first) and a different digest. This vector pins both the conforming digest (jcs_n_correct_digest, same as jcs-n-kat-26) and the non-conforming digest (escaped_sort_contrast_digest).
